free_tier.stated: No storage quota. Per-file ceiling is a single setting: 'Maximum File Upload Size (in bytes) ... Use -1 to remove the limit.'

egress.terms: Your own infrastructure. Cloud-hosted workspaces have a storage limit visible in the admin panel, but self-managed does not.

record.tooling: Rocket.Chat REST API `POST /api/v1/rooms.media/{rid}` + `rooms.mediaConfirm`. Storage backends: GridFS (MongoDB, default), AmazonS3/MinIO, Google Cloud Storage, WebDAV, FileSystem. The WebDAV and S3 backends make it pluggable into anything.
record.chaining: N workspaces x unlimited rooms. The WebDAV backend is the interesting bit: it turns Rocket.Chat into a front-end over any WebDAV store, so it chains rather than multiplies.
record.limits_note: Starter: up to 50 users, self-managed. Community: up to 100 concurrent users, self-hosted only, 10,000 push notifications/month. Per-file limit unlimited if set to -1.
record.reliability_note: Solid; the default GridFS backend stores blobs inside MongoDB, which is a poor choice at TB scale (the docs themselves recommend S3/MinIO). Files can be JWT-protected or public per workspace setting.
